resources.string: Followed by a bad day %1$d of %2$d times (usual: %3$d %%)
A food appears here once you have eaten it at least %1$d times with stools logged the same day or the next.
An observation on what you logged, not a cause. Talk to your doctor or dietitian before removing foods.
Bad day: liquid stool (Bristol 6-7), blood, or pain of 3 and above, the same day or the next.
